title: Manasseh and Amon Reign in Judah

questions.question: How old was Manasseh when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:1 (ESV): "Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: How long did Manasseh reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:1 (ESV): "...and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem."

questions.question: What evil did Manasseh do?
options: He rebuilt the high places, erected altars for Baal, and made an Asherah
questions.correctAnswer: He rebuilt the high places, erected altars for Baal, and made an Asherah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:3 (ESV): "For he rebuilt the high places... and he erected altars for Baal and made an Asherah..."

questions.question: Who succeeded Manasseh?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:18 (ESV): "And Manasseh slept with his fathers... and Amon his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: How did Amon die?
options: His servants conspired against him and killed him in his house
questions.correctAnswer: His servants conspired against him and killed him in his house
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:23 (ESV): "And the servants of Amon conspired against him and put the king to death in his house."

questions.question: Where did Manasseh build altars?
options: In the two courts of the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: In the two courts of the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:5 (ESV): "And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD."

questions.question: What terrible sacrifice did Manasseh perform?
options: He burned his son as an offering
questions.correctAnswer: He burned his son as an offering
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:6 (ESV): "And he burned his son as an offering..."

questions.question: What did the Lord say he would bring upon Jerusalem and Judah because of Manasseh?
options: Disaster that makes both ears tingle
questions.correctAnswer: Disaster that makes both ears tingle
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:12 (ESV): "...Behold, I am bringing upon Jerusalem and Judah such disaster that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle."

questions.question: Who made the people of the land kill the conspirators against Amon?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:24 (ESV): "But the people of the land struck down all those who had conspired against King Amon..."

questions.question: Who was made king after Amon?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:24 (ESV): "...and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place."

questions.question: What metaphor did God use for the destruction of Jerusalem?
options: I will wipe Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down
I will burn it like straw
I will break it like a pot
questions.correctAnswer: I will wipe Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:13 (ESV): "...and I will wipe Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down."

questions.question: How much innocent blood did Manasseh shed?
options: Very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another
questions.correctAnswer: Very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:16 (ESV): "Moreover, Manasseh shed very much innocent blood, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another..."

questions.question: Where was Manasseh buried?
options: In the garden of his house, in the garden of Uzza
In the tombs of the kings
questions.correctAnswer: In the garden of his house, in the garden of Uzza
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:18 (ESV): "And Manasseh slept with his fathers and was buried in the garden of his house, in the garden of Uzza..."

questions.question: How long did Amon reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:19 (ESV): "...and he reigned two years in Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who was Amon's mother?
options: Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah
questions.correctAnswer: Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 21:19 (ESV): "...His mother's name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah."

key_verse_text: Therefore thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: Behold, I am bringing upon Jerusalem and Judah such disaster that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle. (ESV)
